scope: First eight fixed-hash-ranked TRAIN examples per hop stratum from the existing 96-row template: indices 0..7,32..39,64..71. Selection uses no model outputs. The subset and rubric were finalized after viewing these 24 cited traces, so this is exploratory, not preregistered validation. All 72 cited paragraphs were read. Other visible paragraphs are not exhaustively adjudicated. No source label, old score, or old cohort is changed.

labels.E: Cited paragraph supports the requested relation under an ordinary contextual reading; this is not proof of uniqueness, external truth, or whole-chain validity.
labels.A: Relation or referent is materially ambiguous/underspecified in the cited paragraph.
labels.I: Cited paragraph does not establish the requested relation; does not assert that no other visible paragraph supports it.
labels.C: Cited paragraph conflicts with the proposed relation/temporal interpretation.
